author: Mark Atwood
text:
[2026-05-11 decomposition decision] Confirmed with Mark in interactive triage session 2026-05-11. Three decisions:

**1. Trait shape: Shape Y (single `apply_space_patch` method with discriminator enum).**

```rust
enum SpacePatchOp {
    AddRole(Role), RemoveRole(RoleId), UpdateRole(RoleId, RolePatch),
    AddMember(UserId, Vec<RoleId>), RemoveMember(UserId), UpdateMember(UserId, MemberPatch),
    AddChannel(Channel), RemoveChannel(ChannelId), UpdateChannel(ChannelId, ChannelPatch),
    AddCategory(Category), RemoveCategory(CategoryId), UpdateCategory(CategoryId, CategoryPatch),
}

trait ChatBackend: JmapBackend {
    async fn apply_space_patch(
        &self,
        caller: &Self::CallerCtx,
        account_id: &Id,
        space_id: &Id,
        ops: Vec<SpacePatchOp>,
    ) -> Result<Vec<OpResult>, ...>;
}
```

Rationale: draft-atwood-jmap-chat §Space/set defines all 12 mutation keys as sub-ops on a single `/set` patch object with implied single-transaction semantics. Shape Y makes that explicit; Shape X (12 separate methods) would fragment atomicity across 12 calls or force the handler into begin/commit ceremony.

**2. Decomposition: convert this bead to an epic with 6 children.**

- .4.1 — `SpacePatchOp` enum + helper types in `jmap-chat-types` (foundation, must land first)
- .4.2 — `handle_chat_space_set` handler: patch-key parsing, permission-check helpers, count-limit enforcement
- .4.3 — `apply_space_patch` MemoryBackend impl — Role + Member variants (role-hierarchy enforcement cross-cuts both)
- .4.4 — `apply_space_patch` MemoryBackend impl — Channel variants (message cascade on removeChannels)
- .4.5 — `apply_space_patch` MemoryBackend impl — Category variants (channel→uncategorizedChannelIds cascade)
- .4.6 — Integration tests covering all 12 sub-ops + permission/role-hierarchy/cascade/error/edge cases

**3. Sequencing: entire epic blocked on `JMAP-g7wu.1` mega-PR.**

The mutations need `caller` for the 4 permission types (manage_space, manage_roles, manage_members, manage_channels). Without g7wu.1's CallerCtx threading through ChatBackend, the handler has no way to get caller to the backend. Once g7wu.1 lands, .4.1 unblocks.

Bead type changed to `epic`. Removing `human` label. Child beads filed as .4.1-.4.6.
